# Jesus’ Thank You Prayers (Matthew 11:25)

## Emotional Focus
Remembering to say thank You when God answers.

## Key KJV
“I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth.” (Matthew 11:25)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus often stopped to thank His Father out loud. He showed us that saying thank You is a beautiful part of talking to God.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus looking up to heaven with a thankful smile and open hands.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Thank You is a wonderful prayer God loves to hear.”
